scope: Brazilian second division (Campeonato Brasileiro Série B), CBF-recognised editions 1971-2025: 1971-72, 1980-85 (1980-84 as the Taça de Prata), 1988-92, 1994-99, 2001-2025. Not held / not recognised: 1973-79, 1986 (Torneio Paralelo), 1987 (Copa União modules), 1993, 2000 (Copa João Havelange Yellow Module), each with a note. Up to 2005 the title was decided by finals or a final group (format "final"/"playoff"); league format (double round robin) from 2006
source: https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Predefinição:Campeões_do_Campeonato_Brasileiro_de_Futebol_-_Série_B (revision 72743294; champion, final scores, runner-up, 3rd and 4th place every edition)
pt.wikipedia season articles (Campeonato Brasileiro de Futebol de YYYY - Série B): final classification, results grids; table templates 2020-2025
Wikipedia season articles (YYYY Campeonato Brasileiro Série B): tables and points
https://rsssfbrasil.com/tablesae/brYYYYl2.htm (RSSSF Brasil season files 1971-2005: final groups / final tables)
